content: MCP spec revision 2026-07-28 changelog (modelcontextprotocol.io): removes protocol sessions and Mcp-Session-Id; removes initialize handshake (protocol version + capabilities in _meta on every request); adds mandatory server/discover; replaces GET stream with subscriptions/listen; input_required (MRTR) replaces server-initiated elicitation/sampling requests; all results carry resultType; tasks moved to extension io.modelcontextprotocol/tasks; deprecates Roots, Sampling, Logging, HTTP+SSE, and OAuth Dynamic Client Registration in favor of Client ID Metadata Documents (DCR kept for backward compat). Claude Code negotiates 2026-07-28 when the server supports it, else v1 path.
